method.registration: Shared similarity baseline followed by per-bone ICP and one regularized Gaussian RBF displacement field
method.sourceFrame: Bundled Y-up meters; +Z anterior; no axis flip
method.surfaceCrops: Femur includes its 15 source compound leaves excluding cartilage. All patella triangles; femur bottom 90 mm; tibia top 80 mm; crops are not anatomical landmarks
method.sampling: Sampled surface fitting and holdout only, not complete collision validation. 72 even-index source region vertices/bone fit; up to96 odd-index holdout; deterministic evenly spaced indices
method.morph: Apply existing fit-report morph once after registration; body is unchanged
method.normalMethod: Area-weighted normals recomputed from candidate triangles
limitations: One-way surface ICP can have local minima; fitting regions and attachment patches are unreviewed.
Unsigned distances do not establish tissue containment, intersection absence, or functional attachment.
HRA knees are approximately mirrored assembly parts; this is not a validated female-specific joint fit.

knee.status: blocked: joint fit and attachment placement require refinement
blockers: Target attachment landmarks are not reviewed; residuals are geometric proximity evidence only.
Meniscus two-component labels and ligament footprint placement require joint section review before enabling.

quadricepsTendons.status: blocked: patellar interface does not fit
blockers: Existing target quadriceps may already contain distal tendinous geometry; duplication and four-head junction remain unreviewed.

refinement.method: Bone-local similarity ICP then one regularized Gaussian RBF surface displacement
refinement.limitations: Automatic nearest-surface correspondences; no reviewed landmark or endpoint annotations; no soft-tissue points used in fitting.
